data.name: Monish
data.gender_notes: Monish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Monish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Moni', which refers to the Moon God. The suffix 'sh' means 'grace'. Thus, Monish signifies the blessings and grace of the Moon God. The name Monish carries the meaning “Moon God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Monish usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection and tranquility
data.etymology: Monish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Monish total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
